prompt:
Create ONE polished native editable static SVG containing TWO Last Hearth future-expansion creature portraits, normal LEFT and ascended RIGHT. This is visual development, no canon or new rules. Exact 1600x560 canvas/viewBox. Two 800x560 cells. Top-level named groups moth-normal at translate(0 0) and moth-ascended at translate(800 0). Every painted shape belongs to a cell group. Each group begins with its own local 800x560 #172928 background rectangle. Safe subject area x=48..752 y=42..518. No labels, text, card borders, stats, logos, visible writing, watermark or UI. Same creature identity in both cells; deliberately different action, silhouette and supporting structure in ascended, not a recolor or mirror.
STYLE grounded in the existing Hearth illustrations: expressive engraved fantasy, natural creature colors, selective brass, continuous organic curves and three clear modeled value groups. Quiet dark forest field. Ivory upper-left light. Broad planes first; sparse cuts follow form, quiet areas separate accents. Connected head/neck/chest, believable joints, visible load-bearing contact. Small fitted intelligent eyes, no baby mascot eyes. Avoid floating limbs, stacked blobs, stiff tubes, scales everywhere, identical repeated hatching, plastic gloss and all-gold bodies. Compose for 160x112 portrait art and 64x45 board art. No ultra-fine details essential for identity.
Native editable paths and simple shapes, explicit flat paints. No raster, image, use, scripts, animation, external resources, filters, gradients or defs. Every cell extracts cleanly.

SUBJECT: Ember-silk moth. Warm umber/cream moth with a tapered living thorax, small inset eyes, substantial feathered antennae, two pairs of connected overlapping wings, small bent legs. Rust patches restrained in broad planes, no tiny all-over eye spots. NORMAL: side-three-quarter resting moth clings to a diagonal charcoal twig, wings tented in a folded roof with distinct near leading edge, antennae sweep forward. ASCENDED: upright reach from a forked twig with connected legs gripping below, near forewing lifts into a high diagonal sail, far wing opens low and backward, abdomen curves away. Asymmetric wing silhouette reveals continuity into thorax. A living moth, no phoenix flames or human face, no all-gold recolor.
